# arp-notes

> Portable notes-sync component for AI-forward apps. A host app embeds a Python package (FastAPI routers, MCP tool specs, link-scheme ports) and a React UI package; users sync notes from Obsidian (or an LLM) through a small CLI. Adoption is defined as passing the black-box conformance kit.

Links below point at `main`, which is unpinned. For the docs of one release, replace `/main/` with its tag (for example `/v0.1.0/`); the install lines in INTEGRATING.md are pinned by tag.

To integrate arp-notes into a FastAPI + React app, read INTEGRATING.md first and follow it end to end: install, `arp-notes init --host fastapi`, fill in the ports, mount the routes and MCP tools, run the kit until it is green. The wire contract is PROTOCOL.md and the JSON Schemas; every response validates against them. The core is ORM-free: it never touches your models, users table or connections, only the ports you hand it in one HostConfig.

## Integrate

- [INTEGRATING.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/INTEGRATING.md): the one-page recipe, a worked example for every HostConfig field, the React wiring
- [examples/fastapi-minimal/app.py](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/examples/fastapi-minimal/app.py): a complete single-file host (database, auth, one link scheme, routers, MCP) that passes the kit
- [examples/fastapi-minimal/README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/examples/fastapi-minimal/README.md): how to run it and what it demonstrates

## Contract

- [PROTOCOL.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/PROTOCOL.md): the wire contract, protocol version 1 (REST, MCP tools, upload protocol, CLI wire format)
- [JSON Schemas](https://github.com/dneigler/arp-notes/tree/main/packages/core/arp_notes/schemas): one file per REST shape; `examples/` holds valid samples
- [openapi.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/schemas/openapi.json): the OpenAPI document of the routes `build_routers` mounts

## Reference

- [Core package](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/packages/core/README.md): ports, MCP wiring options, tool list
- [Ports and HostConfig](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/packages/core/arp_notes/ports.py): the exact signatures a host implements
- [Conformance kit](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/packages/conformance/README.md): every check, MCP mode, running against a live host
- [CLI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/packages/cli/README.md): `arp-notes init`, `scan`, `sync`, `pull`, `verify`
- [Storage adapters](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/docs/storage.md): disk, Postgres and S3 for attachment bytes
- [Releasing](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/RELEASING.md): tags and the install-by-tag lines

## Optional

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/dneigler/arp-notes/main/README.md): what the project is and the three rules
